name: MACD signal-line cross momentum (Pine import)
rationale: Faithful import of the classic MACD long strategy (Alorse 'MACD Long Strategy [Bunghole]', MACD 12/26/9 + RSI(14); the canonical MACD-cross community pattern): go long when the MACD line crosses ABOVE its signal line (a bullish momentum cross), preferentially after price has recently been oversold. Economic mechanism: MACD = (fast EMA - slow EMA); its signal line is an EMA of that difference, so a bullish MACD-over-signal crossover marks the moment the short-horizon trend's RATE-OF-CHANGE turns up faster than its own recent average — i.e. fresh momentum igniting from a lull. Buying that turn captures the early, least-crowded phase of a directional move (the autocorrelation premium), before the level filters that gate our other momentum specs would fire. We translate the crossover faithfully with the cross_up OPERATOR (not a level threshold): a short-lookback ret_Nd crossing UP through a near-zero floor is the registry-feature equivalent of MACD-line > signal-line turning true (the EMA-difference flips positive as short momentum overtakes its trailing baseline). The Bunghole 'was recently oversold' RSI confluence (RSI(14) had touched its oversold band within the last ~10 bars) maps to an RSI ceiling at entry, so we only take the cross from a non-overbought, mean-reverted base — buying the turn off a dip, not chasing an extended tape. Translation losses (noted, not fabricated): (1) the exact MACD/signal EMA pair is not a registry feature — the cross_up of a fitted-lookback ret_Nd through a fitted floor is the honest, optimizer-fit stand-in for the signal-line cross; (2) Bunghole's 50%/50% SL/TP are extreme placeholders — we replace them with fitted, sane stop/take fractions plus a momentum-fade signal exit; (3) 'barssince oversold <= 10' becomes a same-bar RSI-ceiling confluence (the Finder fits the ceiling). Honest prior: MACD-cross is the most-taught and most-overfit retail signal; net of ~20bps round-trip on crypto spot it is widely shown to be a coin-flip — expected a powered fail that maps the cross surface; the Gate disposes. Disconfirmer: a momentum-fade signal exit (short ret_Nd dropping back below a floor = the cross failed) plus a time-stop bound a false cross.
catalyst: MACD line crosses above its signal line (short-momentum cross_up) from a non-overbought base
